modes.label: Snapshot
modes.cache_rule: Release-scoped static artifacts may use long-lived immutable caching.
modes.replay_rule: Use the immutable release manifest, checksums, schemas, and release URLs for reproducible analysis.
modes.network_behavior: The homepage does not start World Bank, OWID, geoBoundaries, or WorldPop ranking requests in this mode.

modes.label: Live overlay
modes.cache_rule: Browser-time public-source overlays are short lived and source dependent.
modes.replay_rule: Treat live overlay values as current context unless they are materialized into a later immutable release.
modes.network_behavior: The homepage may query public World Bank, OWID, geoBoundaries, and WorldPop surfaces after the user selects this mode.
